description: DiligenceOps: quote the exact escrow terms and fees for a shape before anyone commits. Inputs: amount_usdc, parties (payer, payee), release_condition (time, oracle_attestation, payer_approval, mutual_approval or delivery_attestation) and an optional expires_at. Returns the Wever rail that fits (conditional payment or managed escrow), its live caps and timing windows, release and refund outcomes, every call with its fee and who makes it, the required fee total and any reason the shape does not fit. The quote moves no money and creates no escrow. POST /api/escrow-quote. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence/.

amount_usdc.description: USDC amount as a decimal string, up to 6 places.

expires_at.description: UTC with whole seconds, for example 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z.

release_at.description: UTC with whole seconds, for example 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z.

name: wever_escrow-quote
title: Quote escrow terms
